why: The store holds only the law 05-10 wording of article 101 (five years from discovery, ten years from the conclusion of the contract). Deadlines d1 and d2 would need the earlier wording (ordinance 75-58 version) and the commencement or transitional rule of law 05-10 to say which periods govern a contract concluded, or a fraud discovered, before the 2005 amendment.

Fraud in a contract may also be the offence of swindling (escroquerie); the penal code is not in the store. Wanted only to read around the criminal exit (ordinary-court-exits x6) imported for this claim.
